title: Five Stars
text: Five Stars. Artichokes are very pretty and realistic.

product_metadata.title: Nearly Natural 4686 Artichoke Artificial Flower, 5-Inch, Green, Set of 6,5x5x5
features: Unique artichokes to enhance any space
Great on any table or centerpiece
Sure to add a touch of class
description: The artichoke is an incredibly unique plant – it's both striking to look at and it's delicious to boot. But even though you'll be tempted, don't eat these exact replicas of full, healthy artichokes. Perfectly flowered greens spread out, with their tips touting just a shade of maroon. This set of six will look great on any table or centerpiece, or really add a touch of class to a kitchen. Makes a great gift, too.
